commitResults.messageTitle: Fix: dereferenced contact names lose styling after deletion
commitResults.messageBody:
When a referenced contact is deleted, @{UUID} is replaced with the
plain text name (no special format). NoteLabel only styles active
@{UUID} references, so deleted contact names render as plain white
text as expected.
